text:
aj: Quick heads-up — we need to shift today's release train start from 15:00 -> 15:30 (30m delay). Eng-platform hit a DB migration quirk; devs asked for a short window. Can folks who own slots confirm they can move and who will run smokes?

maria: I can slide slot 2 to 15:30 and take smoke ownership for that slot. :thumbsup:

kevin: I can cover slot 4 smoke and be ready for rollback. I'll coordinate infra handoff.

sara: I'm on call today; can pick up a gap if anyone needs a swap for slot 3.

linda: FYI we should avoid overlapping canary windows w/ dedicated capacity autoscaler spikes. I'll postpone a scheduled burst test until after 16:00.

aj: Perfect. @maria you'll smoke slot 2; @kevin slot 4; @sara standby for slot 3 if needed. @linda thanks for holding the burst. Raph, any objections on policy side?

raph: No objections. Suggest we enable the two-step rollback tag so teams can revert without touching DB migration: use `rollback=true` label on the deploy job.

maria: Smoke checklist (short):
```
- sanity /health
- 1 request to /generate and /embed
- p95 < 250ms for API path
- check logs for ERROR / OOM
- KV cache warmup check
```

kevin: On rollback readiness: I verified last golden image `redwood/serving:v2026-03-12` is promotable. Infra has the image pinned for slot 4 fallback.

deploy-bot: Reminder: canary window for slot 2 scheduled 15:30-15:45. Auto-notify will run at 15:25.

aj: Ok team — plan: shift window, proceed with canaries at 15:30. If any smoke fails, call rollback and ping #eng-oncall. Post results here after your smoke runs (pass/fail + one-liner).

maria: Will post results.

kevin: I'll also leave runbook snippet after smoke: `if p95 > 400ms -> rollback`

sara: Standing by. Good luck, all. :rocket:
